author: Russell Brand
description:
The Epstein scandal raises a question that goes far beyond the island: what were some of the world's most powerful people paying for, and what did they know that the rest of us didn't? Russell is joined by former JPMorgan Vice President Ross Givens to discuss the death of British banker Simon Andriesz, Epstein's financial connections, and allegations of insider trading among America's political elite. They explore how publicly disclosed stock trades can reveal what powerful people are buying—and how ordinary investors can access that same information.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell and his guest discuss how willingly Americans surrendered their freedoms during Covid, and what it exposed about our unquestioning trust in powerful institutions. They explore how a pharmaceutical industry associated with controversies like the opioid crisis and Johnson & Johnson's baby powder scandal suddenly became celebrated and fiercely defended, with some people even getting Pfizer tattoos. Meanwhile, lockdowns gave parents an unexpected glimpse into what their children were being taught in school, raising new questions about the education system and the institutions we've learned to trust.
